name: CSS3 Modern Design Systems & Layout Track
description: Master professional styling from cascade rules to CSS Grid, Flexbox, animations, custom properties, glassmorphism, responsive web design, and production UI engineering.
whatYouLearn: Master CSS specificity, cascade, and inheritance
Engineer complex layouts with Flexbox and 2D CSS Grid
Build responsive UI cards with media queries and container units
Apply dark themes using CSS custom properties (variables)
Build a production-grade Netflix Landing Page UI

exercises.title: CSS Syntax & Basic Selectors
exercises.description: Target HTML elements using element, class, and ID selectors to apply color styles.
exercises.theory: CSS rules consist of a selector and a declaration block containing property: value pairs. Class selectors (.class) target multiple elements, while ID selectors (#id) target unique elements.
exercises.objective: Apply styles using element, class, and ID selectors.
requirements: Create .card class with background #252422 and text color #FFFFFF
hints: Use dot prefix for classes (.card)
Use hash prefix for IDs (#main-header)

exercises.title: The CSS Box Model
exercises.description: Control margin, border, padding, and content dimensions using box-sizing: border-box.
exercises.theory: The CSS Box Model comprises content, padding, border, and margin. Setting box-sizing: border-box includes padding and border within the specified element width.
exercises.objective: Style a container card enforcing explicit box model rules.
requirements: Set .box width to 350px, padding to 24px, and margin to 16px auto
hints: margin: 0 auto centers block elements horizontally
border-box keeps padding inside element dimensions

exercises.title: Color Systems & Gradient Effects
exercises.description: Use HSL colors, RGBA transparency, and linear-gradient background fills.
exercises.theory: CSS supports Hex (#FF6A2A), RGB/RGBA (rgba(255, 106, 42, 0.5)), HSL, and background gradients like linear-gradient().
exercises.objective: Apply a linear gradient background to a call-to-action banner.
requirements: Set text color using RGBA with 0.95 alpha opacity
hints: linear-gradient syntax: linear-gradient(angle, color1, color2)

exercises.title: Typography, Web Fonts & Line Height
exercises.description: Import web fonts and configure font-size, line-height, letter-spacing, and text-transform.
exercises.theory: Clean typography improves readability. Use unit scaling (rem/em), generous line-height (1.5-1.6), and letter-spacing for headers.
exercises.objective: Format article headers and paragraph typography.
requirements: Set body font-family to 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif
Set h1 text-transform to uppercase and letter-spacing to 0.05em
hints: 1rem equals base browser font size (typically 16px)
line-height unitless value (1.6) scales with font-size

exercises.title: CSS Display Property (block, inline, inline-block)
exercises.description: Understand display behaviors and change layout alignment of inline and block elements.
exercises.theory: Block elements take up full container width on a new line. Inline elements flow in line with text. Inline-block accepts width/height while staying in line.
exercises.objective: Convert list items to inline-block navigation buttons.
requirements: Set link display inside .nav-item to block
hints: inline-block allows setting padding and margin while keeping elements side-by-side

exercises.title: Flexbox 1D Layout Engine
exercises.description: Align items along main and cross axes using display: flex, justify-content, and align-items.
exercises.theory: Flexbox provides one-dimensional layout control. justify-content controls main axis alignment, while align-items handles cross axis alignment.
exercises.objective: Build a responsive navigation bar header with centered items.
requirements: Set .navbar display to flex and justify-content to space-between
Use gap property on flex container for spacing
hints: gap adds spacing between flex items without using margins
space-between pushes logo left and menu right
exercises.codeExample: .container { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }

exercises.title: Flexbox Growing, Shrinking & Wrapping
exercises.description: Manage flex-grow, flex-shrink, flex-basis, and flex-wrap properties for card grids.
exercises.theory: flex: flex-grow flex-shrink flex-basis determines how items expand to fill free space or contract when space is tight. flex-wrap allows items to flow to new rows.
exercises.objective: Create a flexible card row that wraps cleanly on narrow viewports.
requirements: Set flex-wrap to wrap on container
hints: flex: 1 1 280px allows items to shrink or grow from a 280px base size

exercises.title: CSS Grid 2D Architecture
exercises.description: Design 2D grid layouts using grid-template-columns, grid-template-rows, and grid-gap.
exercises.theory: CSS Grid handles rows and columns simultaneously. Fractional units (fr) divide available space dynamically among grid tracks.
exercises.objective: Build a 3-column dashboard card grid.
hints: repeat(3, 1fr) creates three tracks each taking 1 fraction of free space

exercises.title: CSS Grid Auto-Fit & Minmax Responsive Layouts
exercises.description: Create responsive grids without media queries using auto-fit and minmax().
exercises.theory: grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr)) creates fluid responsive columns that wrap automatically as viewport dimensions resize.
exercises.objective: Build an auto-responsive image gallery grid.
hints: auto-fit fills empty space by expanding columns
minmax(260px, 1fr) enforces minimum 260px column width

exercises.title: CSS Positioning (relative, absolute, fixed, sticky)
exercises.description: Position badges, sticky headers, and modal overlays using CSS position properties.
exercises.theory: position: absolute positions elements relative to their nearest positioned ancestor (position: relative). position: sticky sticks elements to the viewport top when scrolling.
exercises.objective: Create a sticky navbar and absolute notification badge on a product card.
requirements: Make .sticky-header sticky to top: 0 with z-index 100
Position .badge absolutely to top 12px and right 12px
hints: Parent element must have position: relative for absolute children to align within it
exercises.codeExample:
.parent { position: relative; }
.child { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; }

exercises.title: Pseudo-Classes & Pseudo-Elements
exercises.description: Style state interactions (:hover, :focus-visible, :nth-child) and inserted DOM decorations (::before, ::after).
exercises.theory: Pseudo-classes (:hover, :focus) target dynamic element states. Pseudo-elements (::before, ::after) generate cosmetic DOM nodes without extra HTML elements.
exercises.objective: Create styled button hover/focus effects and custom list bullet badges.
requirements: Add :hover background color change to button
Use ::before on list items with content: '•'
hints: ::before requires content property to render

exercises.title: CSS Custom Properties (Variables) & Theme Toggling
exercises.description: Declare custom CSS variables (:root) to drive color design tokens and dark/light themes.
exercises.theory: CSS variables (--variable-name) inherit down the document tree and can be dynamically reassigned under theme selectors.
exercises.objective: Define a color design system in :root and override tokens under a .dark-theme selector.
hints: Access CSS variables using var(--variable-name)

exercises.title: Responsive Web Design & Media Queries
exercises.description: Adapt component layouts across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints using @media queries.
exercises.theory: Media queries (@media (min-width: 768px)) apply conditional style overrides based on device screen characteristics, enabling mobile-first responsive architecture.
exercises.objective: Create a mobile-first column layout that transforms to a 3-column grid on desktop.
requirements: Write mobile-first single column flex layout
Switch layout to 3-column grid inside tablet/desktop breakpoint
hints: Mobile-first design writes un-nested rules for mobile, then uses min-width media queries for larger viewports

exercises.title: CSS Transitions & Timing Functions
exercises.description: Animate state changes using transition-property, transition-duration, and cubic-bezier curves.
exercises.theory: Transitions smoothly interpolate property changes between pseudo-class state updates (e.g. hover/focus). Specify transition: property duration timing-function.
exercises.objective: Animate card lift and border glow on hover.
requirements: Add transition shorthand for transform, border-color, and box-shadow
Set hover state transform to translateY(-6px)
Set hover border-color to #FF6A2A and add box-shadow
hints: Always define transition on the base element, not only on the :hover state

exercises.title: 2D & 3D CSS Transforms
exercises.description: Manipulate element geometry using translate, rotate, scale, skew, and perspective.
exercises.theory: The transform property modifies spatial rendering without disrupting document flow. Combining rotate, scale, and translate enables GPU-accelerated effects.
exercises.objective: Build a 3D card flip animation structure.
requirements: Set transform-style: preserve-3d on inner card
Rotate Y axis 180 degrees on hover
hints: perspective provides depth perception for 3D rotations
transform-style: preserve-3d propagates 3D space to children

exercises.title: Keyframe Animations & Loading Spinners
exercises.description: Build multi-step keyframe sequences using @keyframes, animation-duration, and animation-iteration-count.
exercises.theory: @keyframes defines multi-stage animation checkpoints. The animation shorthand specifies keyframe name, duration, timing, and iteration count.
exercises.objective: Build a circular IDE spinner using CSS keyframe rotations.
requirements: Set .spinner border with top border color accent #FF6A2A
Apply animation shorthand: spin 1s linear infinite
hints: border-top-color creates the distinct rotating accent arc

exercises.title: Glassmorphism UI Overlays
exercises.description: Craft glassmorphism cards using backdrop-filter: blur(), translucent backgrounds, and crisp borders.
exercises.theory: Glassmorphism combines translucent background colors (rgba), backdrop-filter blur(), subtle borders, and soft drop shadows to simulate frosted glass.
exercises.objective: Build a frosted glass UI card overlay.
requirements: Set background to translucent RGBA rgba(37, 36, 34, 0.6)
Add subtle semi-transparent border and box shadow
hints: Include -webkit-backdrop-filter for Safari compatibility

exercises.title: Custom Scrollbars & Selection Highlights
exercises.description: Style webkit scrollbar tracks and text selection highlights.
exercises.theory: Custom scrollbar rules (::-webkit-scrollbar) and ::selection pseudo-elements brand scroll containers and text highlights to match dark IDE design systems.
exercises.objective: Style IDE scrollbar tracks and active text selection colors.
requirements: Set track background to #1B1B1B and thumb background to #4A4A4A
hints: ::-webkit-scrollbar rules customize Chrome, Edge, and Safari scrollbars

exercises.title: CSS Subgrid & Container Queries
exercises.description: Utilize modern subgrid track inheritance and container queries (@container).
exercises.theory: Container queries (@container) allow components to adapt layout based on their parent container width rather than viewport dimensions.
exercises.objective: Build a container-query component that transforms layout inside narrow card slots.
requirements: Switch card-content flex-direction to row inside query
hints: container-type: inline-size establishes element as a container query context

exercises.title: Capstone Project: Modern Developer Landing Page UI
exercises.description: Engineer a complete responsive landing page layout with a dark theme, sticky navbar, hero section, flex features, grid gallery, and styled buttons.
exercises.theory: This capstone exercise synthesizes modern CSS techniques: variables, flexbox header, responsive CSS grid, transitions, custom scrollbars, and dark IDE design tokens.
exercises.objective: Construct the CSS stylesheet for a developer platform landing page.
requirements: Define CSS variables for color tokens in :root
Build sticky glassmorphism navbar with flexbox
Build responsive auto-fit grid for feature cards
Add hover transition transform and border highlights
hints: Combine CSS Grid auto-fit with sticky positioning and custom property tokens

references.description: Comprehensive documentation for CSS properties and layout specifications

references.description: Visual guides to CSS Flexbox and Grid layout engines
